versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר בִּלְעָם֙ אֶל־בָּלָ֔ק בְּנֵה־לִ֥י בָזֶ֖ה שִׁבְעָ֣ה מִזְבְּחֹ֑ת וְהָכֵ֥ן לִי֙ בָּזֶ֔ה שִׁבְעָ֥ה פָרִ֖ים וְשִׁבְעָ֥ה אֵילִֽים׃

controles.web: Balaam said to Balak, “Build here seven altars for me, and prepare here seven bulls and seven rams for me.”
controles.kjv: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven oxen and seven rams.
controles.livre: E Balaão disse a Balaque: Edifica para mim aqui sete altares, e prepara-me aqui sete bezerros e sete carneiros.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ בָּלָ֔ק כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֣ר בִּלְעָ֑ם וַיַּ֨עַל בָּלָ֧ק וּבִלְעָ֛ם פָּ֥ר וָאַ֖יִל בַּמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃

controles.web: Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on every altar a bull and a ram.
controles.kjv: And Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on every altar a bullock and a ram.
controles.livre: E Balaque fez como lhe disse Balaão: e ofereceram Balaque e Balaão um bezerro e um carneiro em cada altar.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר בִּלְעָ֜ם לְבָלָ֗ק הִתְיַצֵּב֮ עַל־עֹלָתֶךָ֒ וְאֵֽלְכָ֗ה אוּלַ֞י יִקָּרֵ֤ה יְהוָה֙ לִקְרָאתִ֔י וּדְבַ֥ר מַה־יַּרְאֵ֖נִי וְהִגַּ֣דְתִּי לָ֑ךְ וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ שֶֽׁפִי׃

controles.web: Balaam said to Balak, “Stand by your burnt offering, and I will go. Perhaps Yahweh will come to meet me. Whatever he shows me I will tell you.”   He went to a bare height.
controles.kjv: And Balaam said unto Balak, Stand by thy burnt offering, and I will go: peradventure the Lord will come to meet me: and whatsoever he sheweth me I will tell thee. And he went to an high place.
controles.livre: E Balaão disse a Balaque: Põe-te junto a teu holocausto, e eu irei: talvez o SENHOR me virá ao encontro, e qualquer um coisa que me mostrar, eu a contarei a ti. E assim se foi só.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקָּ֥ר אֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶל־בִּלְעָ֑ם וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗יו אֶת־שִׁבְעַ֤ת הַֽמִּזְבְּחֹת֙ עָרַ֔כְתִּי וָאַ֛עַל פָּ֥ר וָאַ֖יִל בַּמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃

controles.web: God met Balaam, and he said to him, “I have prepared the seven altars, and I have offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.”
controles.kjv: And God met Balaam: and he said unto him, I have prepared seven altars, and I have offered upon every altar a bullock and a ram.
controles.livre: E veio Deus ao encontro de Balaão, e este lhe disse: Sete altares ordenei, e em cada altar ofereci um bezerro e um carneiro.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֧שֶׂם יְהוָ֛ה דָּבָ֖ר בְּפִ֣י בִלְעָ֑ם וַיֹּ֛אמֶר שׁ֥וּב אֶל־בָּלָ֖ק וְכֹ֥ה תְדַבֵּֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh put a word in Balaam’s mouth, and said, “Return to Balak, and thus you shall speak.”
controles.kjv: And the Lord put a word in Balaam’s mouth, and said, Return unto Balak, and thus thou shalt speak.
controles.livre: E o SENHOR pôs palavra na boca de Balaão, e disse-lhe: Volta a Balaque, e hás de falar assim.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֣שָׁב אֵלָ֔יו וְהִנֵּ֥ה נִצָּ֖ב עַל־עֹלָת֑וֹ ה֖וּא וְכָל־שָׂרֵ֥י מוֹאָֽב׃

controles.web: He returned to him, and behold, he was standing by his burnt offering, he, and all the princes of Moab.
controles.kjv: And he returned unto him, and, lo, he stood by his burnt sacrifice, he, and all the princes of Moab.
controles.livre: E voltou a ele, e eis que estava ele junto a seu holocausto, ele e todos os príncipes de Moabe.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּשָּׂ֥א מְשָׁל֖וֹ וַיֹּאמַ֑ר מִן־אֲ֠רָם יַנְחֵ֨נִי בָלָ֤ק מֶֽלֶךְ־מוֹאָב֙ מֵֽהַרְרֵי־קֶ֔דֶם לְכָה֙ אָֽרָה־לִּ֣י יַעֲקֹ֔ב וּלְכָ֖ה זֹעֲמָ֥ה יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: He took up his parable, and said,  “From Aram has Balak brought me, the king of Moab from the mountains of the East. Come, curse Jacob for me. Come, defy Israel.
controles.kjv: And he took up his parable, and said, Balak the king of Moab hath brought me from Aram, out of the mountains of the east, saying, Come, curse me Jacob, and come, defy Israel.
controles.livre: E ele tomou sua parábola, e disse: De Arã me trouxe Balaque, rei de Moabe, dos montes do oriente: Vem, amaldiçoa para mim a Jacó; E vem, condena a Israel.

versos.hebraico: מָ֣ה אֶקֹּ֔ב לֹ֥א קַבֹּ֖ה אֵ֑ל וּמָ֣ה אֶזְעֹ֔ם לֹ֥א זָעַ֖ם יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: How shall I curse whom God has not cursed? How shall I defy whom Yahweh has not defied?
controles.kjv: How shall I curse, whom God hath not cursed? or how shall I defy, whom the Lord hath not defied?
controles.livre: Por que amaldiçoarei eu ao que Deus não amaldiçoou? E por que condenarei ao que o SENHOR não condenou?

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־מֵרֹ֤אשׁ צֻרִים֙ אֶרְאֶ֔נּוּ וּמִגְּבָע֖וֹת אֲשׁוּרֶ֑נּוּ הֶן־עָם֙ לְבָדָ֣ד יִשְׁכֹּ֔ן וּבַגּוֹיִ֖ם לֹ֥א יִתְחַשָּֽׁב׃

controles.web: For from the top of the rocks I see him. From the hills I see him. Behold, it is a people that dwells alone, and shall not be reckoned among the nations.
controles.kjv: For from the top of the rocks I see him, and from the hills I behold him: lo, the people shall dwell alone, and shall not be reckoned among the nations.
controles.livre: Porque do cume das penhas o verei, E desde as colinas o olharei: Eis aqui um povo que habitará confiante, e não será contado entre as nações.

versos.hebraico: מִ֤י מָנָה֙ עֲפַ֣ר יַעֲקֹ֔ב וּמִסְפָּ֖ר אֶת־רֹ֣בַע יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל תָּמֹ֤ת נַפְשִׁי֙ מ֣וֹת יְשָׁרִ֔ים וּתְהִ֥י אַחֲרִיתִ֖י כָּמֹֽהוּ׃

controles.web: Who can count the dust of Jacob, or number the fourth part of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous! Let my last end be like his!”
controles.kjv: Who can count the dust of Jacob, and the number of the fourth part of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous, and let my last end be like his!
controles.livre: Quem contará o pó de Jacó, Ou o número da quarta parte de Israel? Morra minha pessoa da morte dos corretos, E meu fim seja como o seu.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר בָּלָק֙ אֶל־בִּלְעָ֔ם מֶ֥ה עָשִׂ֖יתָ לִ֑י לָקֹ֤ב אֹיְבַי֙ לְקַחְתִּ֔יךָ וְהִנֵּ֖ה בֵּרַ֥כְתָּ בָרֵֽךְ׃

controles.web: Balak said to Balaam, “What have you done to me? I took you to curse my enemies, and behold, you have blessed them altogether.”
controles.kjv: And Balak said unto Balaam, What hast thou done unto me? I took thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast blessed them altogether.
controles.livre: Então Balaque disse a Balaão: Que me fizeste? Tomei-te para que amaldiçoes a meus inimigos, e eis que proferiste bênçãos.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֖עַן וַיֹּאמַ֑ר הֲלֹ֗א אֵת֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָשִׂ֤ים יְהוָה֙ בְּפִ֔י אֹת֥וֹ אֶשְׁמֹ֖ר לְדַבֵּֽר׃

controles.web: He answered and said, “Must I not take heed to speak that which Yahweh puts in my mouth?”
controles.kjv: And he answered and said, Must I not take heed to speak that which the Lord hath put in my mouth?
controles.livre: E ele respondeu, e disse: Não observarei eu o que o SENHOR puser em minha boca para dizê-lo?

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֜יו בָּלָ֗ק לך־נָּ֨א אִתִּ֜י אֶל־מָק֤וֹם אַחֵר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּרְאֶ֣נּוּ מִשָּׁ֔ם אֶ֚פֶס קָצֵ֣הוּ תִרְאֶ֔ה וְכֻלּ֖וֹ לֹ֣א תִרְאֶ֑ה וְקָבְנוֹ־לִ֖י מִשָּֽׁם׃

controles.web: Balak said to him, “Please come with me to another place, where you may see them. You shall see just part of them, and shall not see them all. Curse them from there for me.”
controles.kjv: And Balak said unto him, Come, I pray thee, with me unto another place, from whence thou mayest see them: thou shalt see but the utmost part of them, and shalt not see them all: and curse me them from thence.
controles.livre: E disse Balaque: Rogo-te que venhas comigo a outro lugar desde o qual o vejas; sua extremidade somente verás, que não o verás todo; e desde ali me o amaldiçoarás.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקָּחֵ֨הוּ֙ שְׂדֵ֣ה צֹפִ֔ים אֶל־רֹ֖אשׁ הַפִּסְגָּ֑ה וַיִּ֨בֶן֙ שִׁבְעָ֣ה מִזְבְּחֹ֔ת וַיַּ֛עַל פָּ֥ר וָאַ֖יִל בַּמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃

controles.web: He took him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.
controles.kjv: And he brought him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar.
controles.livre: E levou-o ao campo de Zofim, ao cume de Pisga, e edificou sete altares, e ofereceu um bezerro e um carneiro em cada altar.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל־בָּלָ֔ק הִתְיַצֵּ֥ב כֹּ֖ה עַל־עֹלָתֶ֑ךָ וְאָנֹכִ֖י אִקָּ֥רֶה כֹּֽה׃

controles.web: He said to Balak, “Stand here by your burnt offering, while I meet over there.”
controles.kjv: And he said unto Balak, Stand here by thy burnt offering, while I meet the Lord yonder.
controles.livre: Então ele disse a Balaque: Põe-te aqui junto a teu holocausto, e eu irei a encontrar a Deus ali.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקָּ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־בִּלְעָ֔ם וַיָּ֥שֶׂם דָּבָ֖ר בְּפִ֑יו וַיֹּ֛אמֶר שׁ֥וּב אֶל־בָּלָ֖ק וְכֹ֥ה תְדַבֵּֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, “Return to Balak, and say this.”
controles.kjv: And the Lord met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, Go again unto Balak, and say thus.
controles.livre: E o SENHOR saiu ao encontro de Balaão, e pôs palavra em sua boca, e disse-lhe: Volta a Balaque, e assim dirás.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּבֹ֣א אֵלָ֗יו וְהִנּ֤וֹ נִצָּב֙ עַל־עֹ֣לָת֔וֹ וְשָׂרֵ֥י מוֹאָ֖ב אִתּ֑וֹ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לוֹ֙ בָּלָ֔ק מַה־דִּבֶּ֖ר יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: He came to him, and behold, he was standing by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. Balak said to him, “What has Yahweh spoken?”
controles.kjv: And when he came to him, behold, he stood by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. And Balak said unto him, What hath the Lord spoken?
controles.livre: E veio a ele, e eis que ele estava junto a seu holocausto, e com ele os príncipes de Moabe: e disse-lhe Balaque: Que disse o SENHOR?

versos.hebraico: וַיִּשָּׂ֥א מְשָׁל֖וֹ וַיֹּאמַ֑ר ק֤וּם בָּלָק֙ וּֽשֲׁמָ֔ע הַאֲזִ֥ינָה עָדַ֖י בְּנ֥וֹ צִפֹּֽר׃

controles.web: He took up his parable, and said,  “Rise up, Balak, and hear! Listen to me, you son of Zippor.
controles.kjv: And he took up his parable, and said, Rise up, Balak, and hear; hearken unto me, thou son of Zippor:
controles.livre: Então ele tomou sua parábola, e disse: Balaque, levanta-te e ouve; Escuta minhas palavras, filho de Zipor:

versos.hebraico: לֹ֣א אִ֥ישׁ אֵל֙ וִֽיכַזֵּ֔ב וּבֶן־אָדָ֖ם וְיִתְנֶחָ֑ם הַה֤וּא אָמַר֙ וְלֹ֣א יַעֲשֶׂ֔ה וְדִבֶּ֖ר וְלֹ֥א יְקִימֶֽנָּה׃

controles.web: God is not a man, that he should lie, nor the son of man, that he should repent. Has he said, and will he not do it? Or has he spoken, and will he not make it good?
controles.kjv: God is not a man, that he should lie; neither the son of man, that he should repent: hath he said, and shall he not do it? or hath he spoken, and shall he not make it good?
controles.livre: Deus não é homem, para que minta; nem filho de homem para que se arrependa: ele disse, e não fará?; Falou, e não o executará?

versos.hebraico: הִנֵּ֥ה בָרֵ֖ךְ לָקָ֑חְתִּי וּבֵרֵ֖ךְ וְלֹ֥א אֲשִׁיבֶֽנָּה׃

controles.web: Behold, I have received a command to bless. He has blessed, and I can’t reverse it.
controles.kjv: Behold, I have received commandment to bless: and he hath blessed; and I cannot reverse it.
controles.livre: Eis que, eu tomei bênção: E ele abençoou, e não poderei revogá-la.

versos.hebraico: לֹֽא־הִבִּ֥יט אָ֨וֶן֙ בְּיַעֲקֹ֔ב וְלֹא־רָאָ֥ה עָמָ֖ל בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהָיו֙ עִמּ֔וֹ וּתְרוּעַ֥ת מֶ֖לֶךְ בּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: He has not seen iniquity in Jacob. Neither has he seen perverseness in Israel. Yahweh his God is with him. The shout of a king is among them.
controles.kjv: He hath not beheld iniquity in Jacob, neither hath he seen perverseness in Israel: the Lord his God is with him, and the shout of a king is among them.
controles.livre: Não notou iniquidade em Jacó, nem viu perversidade em Israel: o SENHOR seu Deus é com ele, E júbilo de rei nele.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֖ל מוֹצִיאָ֣ם מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם כְּתוֹעֲפֹ֥ת רְאֵ֖ם לֽוֹ׃

controles.web: God brings them out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox.
controles.kjv: God brought them out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn.
controles.livre: Deus os tirou do Egito; Tem forças como de boi selvagem.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י לֹא־נַ֨חַשׁ֙ בְּיַעֲקֹ֔ב וְלֹא־קֶ֖סֶם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כָּעֵ֗ת יֵאָמֵ֤ר לְיַעֲקֹב֙ וּלְיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מַה־פָּ֖עַל אֵֽל׃

controles.web: Surely there is no enchantment with Jacob; Neither is there any divination with Israel. Now it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, ‘What has God done!’
controles.kjv: Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Israel: according to this time it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, What hath God wrought!
controles.livre: Porque em Jacó não há agouro, nem adivinhação em Israel: Como agora, será dito de Jacó e de Israel: O que fez Deus!

versos.hebraico: הֶן־עָם֙ כְּלָבִ֣יא יָק֔וּם וְכַאֲרִ֖י יִתְנַשָּׂ֑א לֹ֤א יִשְׁכַּב֙ עַד־יֹ֣אכַל טֶ֔רֶף וְדַם־חֲלָלִ֖ים יִשְׁתֶּֽה׃

controles.web: Behold, the people rises up as a lioness. As a lion he lifts himself up. He shall not lie down until he eats of the prey, and drinks the blood of the slain.”
controles.kjv: Behold, the people shall rise up as a great lion, and lift up himself as a young lion: he shall not lie down until he eat of the prey, and drink the blood of the slain.
controles.livre: Eis que o povo, que como leão se levantará, E como leão se erguerá: Não se deitará até que coma a presa, E beba o sangue dos mortos.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר בָּלָק֙ אֶל־בִּלְעָ֔ם גַּם־קֹ֖ב לֹ֣א תִקֳּבֶ֑נּוּ גַּם־בָּרֵ֖ךְ לֹ֥א תְבָרֲכֶֽנּוּ׃

controles.web: Balak said to Balaam, “Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.”
controles.kjv: And Balak said unto Balaam, Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.
controles.livre: Então Balaque disse a Balaão: Já que não o amaldiçoas, nem tampouco o abençoes.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֣עַן בִּלְעָ֔ם וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֶל־בָּלָ֑ק הֲלֹ֗א דִּבַּ֤רְתִּי אֵלֶ֨יךָ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֹת֥וֹ אֶֽעֱשֶֽׂה׃

controles.web: But Balaam answered Balak, “Didn’t I tell you, saying, ‘All that Yahweh speaks, that I must do?’”
controles.kjv: But Balaam answered and said unto Balak, Told not I thee, saying, All that the Lord speaketh, that I must do?
controles.livre: E Balaão respondeu, e disse a Balaque: Não te disse que tudo o que o SENHOR me disser, aquilo tenho de fazer?

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר בָּלָק֙ אֶל־בִּלְעָ֔ם לְכָה־נָּא֙ אֶקָּ֣חֲךָ֔ אֶל־מָק֖וֹם אַחֵ֑ר אוּלַ֤י יִישַׁר֙ בְּעֵינֵ֣י הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים וְקַבֹּ֥תוֹ לִ֖י מִשָּֽׁם׃

controles.web: Balak said to Balaam, “Come now, I will take you to another place; perhaps it will please God that you may curse them for me from there.”
controles.kjv: And Balak said unto Balaam, Come, I pray thee, I will bring thee unto another place; peradventure it will please God that thou mayest curse me them from thence.
controles.livre: E disse Balaque a Balaão: Rogo-te que venhas, te levarei a outro lugar; porventura comparecerá bem a Deus que desde ali me o amaldiçoes.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקַּ֥ח בָּלָ֖ק אֶת־בִּלְעָ֑ם רֹ֣אשׁ הַפְּע֔וֹר הַנִּשְׁקָ֖ף עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הַיְשִׁימֹֽן׃

controles.web: Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, that looks down on the desert.
controles.kjv: And Balak brought Balaam unto the top of Peor, that looketh toward Jeshimon.
controles.livre: E Balaque levou a Balaão ao cume de Peor, que está voltado até Jesimom.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר בִּלְעָם֙ אֶל־בָּלָ֔ק בְּנֵה־לִ֥י בָזֶ֖ה שִׁבְעָ֣ה מִזְבְּחֹ֑ת וְהָכֵ֥ן לִי֙ בָּזֶ֔ה שִׁבְעָ֥ה פָרִ֖ים וְשִׁבְעָ֥ה אֵילִֽים׃

controles.web: Balaam said to Balak, “Build seven altars for me here, and prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me here.”
controles.kjv: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven bullocks and seven rams.
controles.livre: Então Balaão disse a Balaque: Edifica para mim aqui sete altares, e prepara-me aqui sete bezerros e sete carneiros.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ בָּלָ֔ק כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר אָמַ֣ר בִּלְעָ֑ם וַיַּ֛עַל פָּ֥ר וָאַ֖יִל בַּמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃

controles.web: Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.
controles.kjv: And Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar.
controles.livre: E Balaque fez como Balaão lhe disse; e ofereceu um bezerro e um carneiro em cada altar.
